title: 第0015章寂泥煨魂第0016章玄界泪归
content_zh:
第0015章寂泥煨魂城市博物馆，闭馆后。
这座百年建筑像一头沉睡的巨兽，花岗岩外墙爬满藤蔓，青铜门环锈迹斑斑。穹顶之下，展厅林立，陈列着从新石器时代到近代的文物。可真正的秘密，藏在地下——**地库第七层**，一个从不对外开放的区域。
巴刀鱼三人潜入通风管道，借着月光观察下方。
地库空旷，水泥地面，四壁冰冷。中央，有一口井。
不是普通水井。
井口由整块黑石凿成，井沿刻满符文，与“刀鱼小灶”那口镇灶上的“厨神印”同源。井口无水，只有一团**灰雾**在缓缓旋转，如活物呼吸。
“命脉井。”娃娃鱼闭眼，指尖轻颤，“老城的‘地气’从这里汇聚。三百年前，‘厨渊’被封，主厨将‘寂火’封于此井，用‘静土’为薪，煨了七百年，才镇住地脉躁动。”
“所以‘黑陶煨寂’的引子，是井底的‘寂泥’？”酸菜汤问。
“对。”娃娃鱼点头，“可这井，是‘活’的。它在‘听’。任何活物靠近，都会被它感知，引发‘地怒’。”
巴刀鱼不语，掌心金纹微亮，金焰骨、赤米在玉匣中同步震颤，像是在呼应井中的“寂火”。
“他们知道我们要来。”他低声道，“‘食魇’不会让‘寂泥’轻易得手。这地库，是‘瓮’。”
“那就砸了它。”酸菜汤握拳，火煞凝聚。
“不。”巴刀鱼摇头，“‘命脉井’是城之根本。硬闯，会伤地气，整座城都会遭殃。我们必须……‘静’入。”
“静？”酸菜汤冷笑，“你当这是泡茶？”
“不。”巴刀鱼摘下厨师帽，露出额角新愈的伤疤，“是‘死’入。”
他从怀中取出父亲的铁盒，打开，取出那张泛黄纸。
纸上“厨神印”缓缓旋转，最终定格——
**一口锅，锅下无火，锅中一人，静坐如尸**。
“‘寂火’不燃活物，只煨静土。”巴刀鱼低语，“要取‘寂泥’，必须有人……以‘死身’入井。”
“你疯了？！”酸菜汤怒吼，“你进去就是真死！”

“不。”巴刀鱼摇头，“我有‘心火’护魂。只要娃娃鱼用‘听魂术’拴住我，我就能在‘死’中行走，取泥而出。”
娃娃鱼闭眼，指尖发抖：“可这太险……‘寂火’能焚魂，稍有差池，你魂飞魄散，连轮回都入不了。”
“可总得有人去。”巴刀鱼站起，“父亲用血祭守灶，我用‘死身’取泥，不违厨道。”
他脱下外套，只穿一件白衬衫，将玉匣交给酸菜汤。
“我在井下，会断绝所有气息。若七日未出，你带娃娃鱼走，别管我。”
“放屁！”酸菜汤怒吼，“老子等你七日！七日零一分钟，老子也给你炸了这井！”
巴刀鱼笑了，拍了拍他肩膀。
他走向井口。
娃娃鱼闭眼，三根银针悬空，针尖连向巴刀鱼心口，形成一道极细的银线。
“我拴着你。”她轻声道，“别走太远。”
巴刀鱼点头，深吸一口气，纵身跃入井中！
**命脉井·寂火渊**
井下，无底。
巴刀鱼下坠，却感觉不到风，听不到声。四周只有灰雾，缓缓旋转，如时间之河。
突然，下坠停止。
他站在一片**灰土平原**上。
天是灰的，地是灰的，风是静的。
远处，一口巨锅，静静燃烧。
锅下无火。
可锅中，却有**灰焰**在跳动，无声无息，却让整个空间都在颤抖。

锅旁，站着一人。
穿厨师服，戴厨师帽，背对着他。
“父亲……？”巴刀鱼喃喃。
那人缓缓转身。
content_en:
Chapter 0015 Silent Mud Simmering Soul City Museum, after closing.
This century-old building looks like a sleeping giant, with its granite exterior walls covered with vines and rusty bronze door knockers. Under the dome, there are many exhibition halls displaying cultural relics from the Neolithic Age to modern times. But the real secret is hidden underground - the seventh floor of the basement, an area that is never open to the outside world.
The three of them sneaked into the ventilation duct and looked down through the moonlight.
The basement is empty, with a concrete floor and cold walls. In the center, there is a well.
Not an ordinary well.
The mouth of the well is hewn from a whole piece of black stone, and the edges of the well are engraved with runes, which have the same origin as the "Seal of the God of Cooking" on the stove of the "Swordfish Xiaozao". There is no water at the mouth of the well, only a cloud of gray mist spinning slowly, like the breathing of a living creature.
"Lifeline Well." Baby Fish closed his eyes and trembled at his fingertips, "The 'earth energy' of the old city gathered here. Three hundred years ago, the 'Cooking Abyss' was sealed, and the chef sealed the 'silent fire' in this well, using 'quiet soil' as fuel, and simmered it for seven hundred years before the restlessness of the earth veins was suppressed."
"So the introduction of 'Black Pottery Simmering Silence' is the 'Silent Mud' at the bottom of the well?" Sauerkraut Tang asked.
"Yes." The giant salamander nodded, "But this well is 'alive'. It is 'listening'. Any living creature that comes close will be sensed by it and trigger 'earth fury'."
The fish was silent, the golden pattern on its palm shimmered slightly, and the golden flame bones and red rice trembled simultaneously in the jade box, as if echoing the "silent fire" in the well.
"They knew we were coming." He whispered, "The Nightmare Eater won't let Jini get it easily. This basement is an Urn."
"Then smash it." Sauerkraut Tang clenched his fist, and the fire spirit condensed.
"No." Badaoyu shook his head, "The 'Lifeline Well' is the foundation of the city. Breaking in forcefully will hurt the earth's energy and the whole city will suffer. We must... enter quietly."
"Jing?" Sauerkraut Soup sneered, "Do you think this is making tea?"
"No." The swordfish took off his chef's hat, revealing the newly healed scar on his forehead, "It's death."
He took out his father's iron box from his arms, opened it, and took out the yellowed paper.
The "Chef God Seal" on the paper slowly rotated and finally settled——
**There is a pot, there is no fire under the pot, and there is a person in the pot, sitting quietly like a corpse**.
"The 'Silent Fire' does not burn living things, it only simmers the quiet earth." The swordfish whispered, "To get the 'Silent Mud', someone must... enter the well with a 'dead body'."
"Are you crazy?!" Sauerkraut Soup roared, "You will really die if you go in!"
"No." The Batfish shook his head, "I have the 'Heart Fire' to protect my soul. As long as the Batfish uses the 'Soul Listening Technique' to tie me down, I can walk in 'death' and get out of the mud."
Baby Fish closed his eyes and his fingertips trembled: "But this is too dangerous...'Silent Fire' can burn the soul. If there is a slight mistake, your soul will be scattered and you will not be able to enter the reincarnation."
"But someone has to go." Baoyu stood up, "My father sacrificed blood to guard the stove, and I used my 'dead body' to get the mud. It's not against the cooking rules."
He took off his coat, wearing only a white shirt, and handed the jade box to pickled cabbage soup.
"I will cut off all breath when I'm down in the well. If I don't come out in seven days, you take the baby fish away and leave me alone."
"Fart!" Pickled Cabbage Soup roared, "I'll wait for you for seven days! In seven days and one minute, I'll blow up this well for you too!"
The fish smiled and patted him on the shoulder.
He walked towards the well.
The giant salamander closed its eyes, and three silver needles were hanging in the air. The needle points were connected to the heart of the giant salamander, forming a very thin silver line.
"I'll tie you up." She whispered, "Don't go too far."
The bass fish nodded, took a deep breath, and jumped into the well!
**Lifeline Well·Silent Fire Abyss**
Down the well, there is no bottom.
The bass fish fell, but could not feel the wind or hear the sound. There is only gray mist all around, slowly rotating like the river of time.
Suddenly, the fall stopped.
He stood on a plain of dust.
The sky is gray, the ground is gray, and the wind is calm.
In the distance, a huge pot burned quietly.
There is no fire under the pot.
But in the pot, there was **grey flame**It was beating silently, but it made the whole space tremble.
Beside the pot, there was a person standing.
Wear chef clothes and hat, with your back turned to him.
"Father...?" Batio fish murmured.
The man turned around slowly.
